title: Kakamega Forest National Reserve
supports: Central African tropical rainforest remnant; Important Bird Area; primates, birds, butterflies, waterfall and nature trails; visitor preparation advice
hidden_gem_rationale: A biodiversity-rich rainforest walk far from Kenya's headline safari circuit, with distinctive Central African ecology.

title: Saiwa Swamp National Park
supports: Kenya's smallest national park; wetland boardwalk; sitatunga, De Brazza's monkey and birdlife; access and visitor preparation advice
hidden_gem_rationale: A compact boardwalk park centred on rare wetland species rather than the country's familiar big-game destinations.

title: Ruma National Park
supports: Lambwe Valley setting; Kenya's remaining sanctuary for endangered roan antelope; game viewing and guided walks; Homa Bay approach
hidden_gem_rationale: The country's specialist roan-antelope sanctuary receives far less attention than Kenya's flagship savannah parks.

title: Kisite-Mpunguti Marine Park and Reserve
supports: Marine park and reserve; snorkelling, diving and boat safaris; coral habitat, turtles and dolphins; Shimoni coast setting

title: Mwea National Reserve
supports: Tana and Thiba river setting; dams and waterbirds; Pel's fishing owl and endemic Hinde's babbler; dirt-road access and preparation advice
hidden_gem_rationale: A low-profile river-and-dam reserve whose specialised birdlife rewards travellers looking beyond marquee mammals.

title: Ndere Island National Park
supports: Lake Victoria island park; hiking and picnics; impala, zebra, hippo, crocodile and fish eagle; boat access from Kisumu
hidden_gem_rationale: A small boat-access island walk with wildlife and lake views, distinct from Kenya's established overland safari routes.

title: Kora National Park
supports: Kora inselbergs, Tana River and conservation heritage; 280 km north-east of Nairobi; entire road network requires 4WD; visitors should carry water and food
hidden_gem_rationale: A remote 4WD-only park beyond Kenya's standard safari circuit, with specific riverine scenery and conservation history rather than a relabelled headline reserve.

title: Hikes, Walks and Trails - Karoo National Park
supports: 400-metre paved wheelchair-accessible trail; genuine fossils and petrified wood
hidden_gem_rationale: A short, accessible palaeontology trail within a large landscape park, easily missed beside the Karoo's longer drives.

title: 4x4 Trails - Karoo National Park
supports: Six-kilometre Pienaars Pass 4x4 route; challenging and unsuitable for beginners; registration and additional fee required
hidden_gem_rationale: A purpose-built technical route inside Karoo National Park for experienced drivers rather than a standard scenic loop.

title: Birds - West Coast National Park
supports: Geelbek bird hide; lagoon is a Ramsar site; rising-tide timing brings feeding waders closer; smaller species move first
hidden_gem_rationale: A tide-timed birdwatching experience that is quieter and more specialised than the park's famous flower season.

title: Things to do in Mountain Zebra National Park over the holidays
supports: Guided Salpeterkop hike; strenuous climb and fitness requirement; South African War history; booking and age considerations
hidden_gem_rationale: A demanding history-rich summit walk that sits outside the park's better-known wildlife drives.

title: Fishing - Mokala National Park
supports: Catch-and-release fly fishing on the Riet River; Lilydale section; high-clearance or 4x4 access needed for some fishing locations
hidden_gem_rationale: A specialised river activity in an under-the-radar national park, distinct from South Africa's standard wildlife-drive itineraries.

publisher: Egypt Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
title: Beni Hasan
supports: Middle Kingdom cemetery; upper cemetery contains 39 rock-cut tombs, 12 decorated; daily-life scenes; visitor hours
hidden_gem_rationale: A cliff cemetery with unusually vivid everyday scenes, away from Egypt's heavily visited Cairo and Luxor monument clusters.

publisher: Egypt Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
title: Temple of Dendera
supports: Well-preserved Temple of Hathor; astronomical ceiling; roof panorama and underground chambers; separate tickets for additional areas
hidden_gem_rationale: Its intact architecture and optional roof and subterranean spaces make Dendera a richer visit than its lower profile suggests.

publisher: Egypt Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
title: The Temple of Medinet Habu
supports: Ramesses III mortuary temple; preserved battle scenes; royal palace, storehouses and stables in wider complex; visitor hours
hidden_gem_rationale: A highly preserved West Bank complex that is commonly overshadowed by the Valley of the Kings and nearby major temples.

publisher: Egypt Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
title: A Special Virtual Tour of Gayer-Anderson Museum
supports: Two historic Islamic houses; salamlek and haramlek spaces; collection of art and objects; architectural and cultural interpretation
hidden_gem_rationale: An intimate domestic-architecture museum that reveals a different side of Cairo from its monumental headline sites.

publisher: Egypt Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
title: Aswan Visitor's Guide
supports: Short boat ride to Elephantine; ancient houses and temple remains; Nilometer; museum; visitor hours
hidden_gem_rationale: A layered island site combining settlement archaeology and Nile measurement within easy reach of central Aswan.
